intent: Build the PROPOSAL GATE (spec 2d): echelon_engine/propose.py with check (PROPOSAL-GATE §3 rule-for-rule, name-only PILOT mode, report + CHG on PROCEED), bind (§5 drift/usages/loc/edge, 2c receipt), resolve (propose_scan.similar wrapper), verdict, load_proposal, main; register the echelon propose|index verbs; write tests/test_propose.py per §5; the gate checks its OWN proposal first (§9 of the integration contract).

budget.override_reason: spec 2d §1 caps CODE at propose.py ≤420 + test_propose.py ≤300 + __main__.py +≤6; landed 458 code-only / 510 non-blank (propose.py) and 470 code-only / 503 non-blank (test_propose.py). propose.py: the 33 §3 rule ids × evidence/fix payload IS the gate's product (2b precedent: propose_scan declared 441 vs 400, accepted as dense-no-padding). test_propose.py: spec §5's own list (36 rule ids + pilot/semantic + CHG + never-raise ×4 preconditions + 7 bind rules + CLI exits + resolve + self-gate ≈ 52 tests) cannot fit 300 lines — the scan precedent is 297 lines for 20 tests; this suite carries 2.6× the mandated coverage. Declared loc 1350 covers the whole committed diff a bind would measure (~510+~503 code + ~6 wiring + ~330 proposal/report JSON, spec §5 requires them committed)

steps.do: write echelon_engine/propose.py: constants (DUP thresholds with the §3 note, TYPE_BUDGETS START values), load_proposal, _finding, the eight check steps, verdict (ack-aware), check (report + journal + CHG on PROCEED), bind (git diff, rescan-diff symbols, usages, loc via _strip_line, receipt, DRIFT-EDGE, CHG bound), resolve, main

write tests/test_propose.py per spec §5: one test per §3 rule id, pilot/semantic switching, CHG open/reuse, never-raise (missing room/index/git, malformed/v>1/missing proposal), bind rules on a real git repo, receipt + _verify_violations, CLI exit codes 0/1/2, resolve top match, and the self-gate test (check on THIS proposal over a rescan of propose_scan/contracts/workcycle, asserts PROCEED)
register "propose" -> propose.main and "index" -> propose_scan.main in echelon_engine/__main__.py; prove both --help exit 0

self-check in the worktree room: index scan the three modules, propose check docs/proposals/PROP-2026-08-27-propose-gate.json -> expect PROCEED; commit the report as docs/proposals/PROP-2026-08-27-propose-gate.report.json; remove the room

unknowns.q: whether references to stdlib modules (path "stdlib") must resolve in the index
unknowns.ruling: no — the 2b proposal's path:"stdlib" convention marks stdlib; the gate records them as "stdlib" edges without lookup or finding (a real gate that flagged `json` would false-block every proposal)

unknowns.q: whether the proposal's own files (the .json it is written in, and its .report.json) trip TOUCH-CREATE-EXISTS at check time
unknowns.ruling: mode semantics (round-1 heal): `create` is legitimate only BEFORE the build — a touch whose file exists at check time in the SAME commit as the proposal is honestly declared `edit`. The first committed report was manufactured from a mini-tree that excluded the files whose existence REJECTs; the honest re-check declares them edit. The TOUCH-CREATE-EXISTS exemption is scoped to the room's own files only — <room>/proposals/<id>.json and <room>/proposals/<id>.report.json (repo-relative .echelon/proposals/...), never a basename anywhere. This committed copy therefore declares mode edit for propose.py, test_propose.py and both docs/proposals files — they exist in this commit; the report is the artifact of an honest re-check of that copy against the real index (base = a real commit in this repo, verdict stated as-is)

unknowns.q: whether bind moves CHG-* to changes/completed
unknowns.ruling: no — workcycle checkpoint moves it (INTEGRATION-CONTRACT §1); bind only sets bound:true + bound_at + history_receipt

unknowns.q: how deep the why_not_reuse citation check goes with no model in the loop
unknowns.ruling: lexical: the candidate's name must appear in why_not_reuse and the text must be substantial (>30 chars) — a cheap gate, the Opus round-1 gate re-derives it

unknowns.q: whether a bind with warnings still marks the CHG bound
unknowns.ruling: yes — warnings are acked/visible; only errors block (ok=false keeps the CHG open)
